standards.response_note_zh: 共行车道设计不得侵占无障碍通行空间：行人优先段与无障碍配送通道符合无障碍环境建设法理念（第39条范围公开场所）。
standards.response_note_en: Robot lanes must not occupy barrier-free passage: pedestrian-priority segments and barrier-free delivery channels follow the Barrier-Free Environment Law (Art.39 scope).
